reviews.review: lighthearted game for some, deep enough for others (like me). if you're expecting a game like the original Mass Effect trilogy i don't think this is for you; however, if you want a decent continuation and a laugh or two, give it a shot.

I know that the story is quite bad and tedious, and barely makes sense, but gameplay is incredible, especially if you play as a vanguard. If you want to play semi-interesting missions with your brain turned off, this is a game for you

I thought it was a great game originally. Had a few mods that tweaked it the way I liked it. Played last night and then today...boom. Mods not working and it goes back to having to launch it from Origin desktop. I think I am done with EA and anything that uses EA play. Shame really.

There are a lot of hidden gems in this game. For example, side quests that are great fun are hidden in the Heleus galaxy, which is huge. Every world you can explore spans days/weeks/months' worth of content (depending on how often and how much you get to play the game).

It also features some classic voice lines that can play randomly while you are exploring. Who doesn't love when Drack says, ||"I've eaten things older than all of you"||? Or when Peebee reveals their ||father was an Elcor||. These voice lines include other funny moments like Liam's first attempts to befriend Drack or Jaal's attempts to understand Milky Way culture.

Also, the game still looks pretty. It's rare that the views in games that are over eight years old seem just as nice as views in new games. This is one game that held up. 

If you want to play a sci-fi game where you can choose the gender of your protagonist, be in way over your head trying to turn a new galaxy into a livable one, have an endless to-do list you can pick from, and keep a sense of humour, then this game is for you. It is really freeing playing someone who is new to everything and figuring things out for the good of an entire new galaxy. Any mistakes are just growth.

TLDR: Think of this game as Skyrim if you were an inexperienced space hero trying to do the right thing.

Unfortunately it is a victim of culture of hate. Everything good that game has was overlooked and as a result we dont have any more ME games anymore. Despite story not being the strongest, game provide good gameplay, interesting exploration and cool visuals. It is just a good(above average) game, not epic awesome like previous, certainly not bad.
